universal_lens: The LineStar slate grid defines a high-dimensional state manifold where anonymous API truncation acts as a projection operator. The underlying geometry unifies market priors (Vegas), physical constraints (weather slices), and latent biological states (injuries) into a single, sparse observable tensor.
